SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, '0' AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD A WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRSTX-0002', 'KRSTX-0003', 'KRSTX-0005', 'KRSTX-0006', 'KRSTX-0007') AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' UNION SELECT B.BUYER, B.INV_NO, '2' AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.BUYER IN ('KRSTX-0002', 'KRSTX-0003', 'KRSTX-0005', 'KRSTX-0006', 'KRSTX-0007') AND B.SND_CHK = 'N' GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.INV_NO ORDER BY BUYER, INV_NO
